CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   D. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   B. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   B. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   C. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inspired Word of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Ten Commandments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. B — Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. A — Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. B — Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A — Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Leisure; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inspired Word of God; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Ten Commandments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
